items.title: DISTANCE
items.quote: Why, Hashem do You stand at a distance?
items.text: Plead with Hashem not to remain distant from you, especially if you are in trouble and are desperate for His help.

items.title: ARROGANCE
items.quote: In the arrogance of the rasha he hunts down the poor.
items.text: Take special care to avoid arrogance, which is the attitude of the wicked. Because of it they feel free to victimize innocent people.

items.title: SELF-DESTRUCTION OF THE WICKED
items.quote: May [the resha’im] be caught in the very schemes they have contrived.
items.text: Ask that people who want to harm you be disabled through their own actions, without the need for your active involvement.
“There is no G-d” [is the basis of] all his scheming.” Don’t fall into the trap of the wicked who disregard the presence of Hashem when they wish to do what they know He abhors
items.title: HASHEM IS ALWAYS THERE
PROSPERITY OF THE WICKED
items.text: Don’t let yourself be misled or demoralized by the apparent success of the wicked, no matter how convincing it looks. They succeed because they are not restrained by conscience or morality, but they will pay a heavy price for their crimes.

items.title: URGENCY
items.quote: Arise, Hashem. G-d, lift Your hand, don’t forget the humble.
items.text: Plead with Hashem to act immediately to bring the yeshuah for which you have been praying so long.

items.title: DISABLING THE WICKED
items.quote: Break the power of the rasha.
items.text: Plead with Hashem to bring the evil power of resha’im to an end so that their victims are freed from their cruelty.

items.title: ETERNITY
items.text: Hashem rules the world for all time and any appearance of imbalance in the scheme of things will ultimately be resolved.

items.w: בל יוסיף עוד לערץ אנוש מן הארץ
items.quote: [The rasha] will no longer continue to terrorize any earthly mortal.
